title: Sanlam Cape Town Marathon – FAQ / Two Starts
claims: The Cape Town Marathon uses two start areas and five waves.
The course finishes on Vlei Road in Green Point.
The official route is approximately 42.2 km.
The official FAQ describes the 2026 two-start arrangement; the 2027 edition may change.
